data.title: 贝塔 · 四越王都签售会的大作家风采
data.description: 四越商会水晶吊灯照耀的奢华大礼堂内，签名桌上摞满精装畅销书。化名夏目老师的贝塔双手交叠托腮，向读者展露优雅从容的招牌微笑。
data.location: grand crystal chandelier banquet hall lined with book displays and red velvet stanchions
data.action: seated behind a long ornate signing desk stacked with hardcover novels, hands clasped beneath chin, smiling warmly and elegantly toward crowd
data.lighting: 水晶吊灯暖金光与午后漫射光
data.promptProse: Beta as author Natsume sits behind a desk loaded with signed novels under a crystal chandelier, smiling gracefully with hands clasped under her chin.
data.animaCaption: Chandelier light gleams on her novel stacks as she greets the room with a serene smile.
